content:
Data verification is the step that confirms a figure is true before anyone acts on it. Most teams skip it, and most errors slip through for that reason.

## Start with the source

Name where each number came from. Write down who published it and when. The [how it works](/how-it-works) page shows the full flow from raw file to reviewed result.

### Check the date

Old data misleads. A figure that was right last year may be wrong now, so confirm the date matches the decision you are making.

## Review before sharing

Have a second person read anything that drives a decision. Our guide to [data validation](/data-validation) explains how this differs from verification, and the [trust index](/trust-index) shows how we score evidence.
